source_scope: adopted publisher Version of Record full HTML; standalone Supplementary Information identity retained but its unseen standalone content is not new Stage-A evidence
source_loci: Methods ECPG objective and latent encoder/decoder policy
internal_state: learned encoder parameters mapping environmental state to latent representation
learned decoder/action-policy parameters mapping latent representation to action
learned compressed representation; test-time retention is not reclassified as a coordinator
observed_or_input_variables: novel test stimuli/states in the generalization phase
action_or_control_variables: action sampled/chosen from decoder policy conditioned on latent representation
update_operators: policy-gradient optimization of encoder and decoder under coupled reward/compression objective
representation compression driven by mutual-information penalty
source-defined initialization/pretraining where used is distinct from task learning
value_or_policy_quantities: combined efficient-coding objective: reward minus lambda-weighted representational information
gating_or_selection_rules: latent encoder determines which compressed representation reaches the action decoder; lambda is a model hyperparameter, not a separate controller
learning_rule: policy-gradient parameter learning under reward-plus-compression objective; generic policy-gradient machinery is inherited
temporal_ordering: testing on new states using learned representation/policy without introducing online coordination state
environmental_or_task_variables: training/test split and stimulus associations are experimenter-defined
feature-based variants use experimenter-defined feature embeddings and are not autonomous feature-learning evidence
model_alternatives: CPG relation at zero compression penalty
source_defined_controller_hierarchy: encoder and decoder compose the source policy; no additional meta-controller is asserted
negative_or_adverse_results: feature variants rely on experimenter-defined embedding
model fitting does not establish an independently cross-validated neural implementation
computational success is not direct neural-mechanism evidence
reset_or_reinitialization_boundary: training-to-test phase change is experimenter-defined; learned representation is retained but active learning during test is not inferred merely from continued performance
